0|f1d505bb762e30bf316ff5d3b604914649d6aed3|torvalds~linux|/home/usuario01/Titan-Files-Research/src/_00/output/C/torvalds~linux|False|"netfilter: nf_tables: fix type mismatch with error return from nft_parse_u32_check
Commit 36b701fae12ac (""netfilter: nf_tables: validate maximum value of
u32 netlink attributes"") introduced nft_parse_u32_check with a return
This patch corrects the mismatch by changing the return value to ""int""
which happens to match the actual users of nft_parse_u32_check already.
Note that commit 21a9e0f1568ea (""netfilter: nft_exthdr: fix error
handling in nft_exthdr_init()) attempted to address the issue
did not address the return type of nft_parse_u32_check.
